_comment: Some gemeentes explicitly extend the wildplas-verbod to areas outside the bebouwde kom. gemeente must be the OFFICIAL PDOK Locatieserver name (e.g. "'s-gravenhage", not "den haag"; "'s-hertogenbosch", not "den bosch") since that's what /api/check's reverse-geocode lookup returns. Two ways to match within a gemeente: (1) `plaats_bevat` — a lowercase substring of `plaats` (the PDOK kern name), good when the named area effectively IS the kern. (2) `center` {lat, lon} + `radius_m` — a point-radius match, required when the APV designates a SMALL specific area (a JOP, a parking lot, a strip of beach) that shares its `plaats` value with the surrounding village/town; a plaats_bevat match there would wrongly flag the whole place. This list is a starting point, not exhaustive — extend as you research more APVs. NOTE (2026-08-24): the previous 's-gravenhage/Haagse Bos entry was removed — it linked to an old APV version (CVDR11313/14), and the currently in-force Den Haag APV (CVDR11313/70, checked via lokaleregelgeving.overheid.nl) no longer mentions 'Haagse Bos' or even the word 'bos' anywhere in its natuurlijke-behoefte article (artikel 4:8) or the rest of the text — that carve-out appears to have been repealed at some point between those versions. Re-add it (with a current apv_url) only if you find it's actually still in force somewhere, e.g. via a separate aanwijzingsbesluit.
